models_evaluated: rpCVD (deep learning retinal photograph-based CVD risk score)

links.outcome: Predictive accuracy of AI rpCVD score versus WHO CVD risk score for 10-year incident CVD
links.effect: rpCVD AUC = 0.672 (95% CI: 0.658-0.686) versus WHO CVD risk score AUC = 0.693 (95% CI: 0.680-0.707); comparable accuracy using retinal images alone.
links.quote: Despite this, the rpCVD system, which relies solely on retinal images, demonstrated a similar level of accuracy in predicting 10-year incident CVD (AUC = 0.672, 95% CI: 0.658-0.686) compared to the WHO CVD risk score (AUC = 0.693, 95% CI: 0.680-0.707).

unlisted_practices: Automated retinal photography imaging success rate (image quality sufficiency) as a feasibility measure in primary care

screen.reason: Evaluates feasibility, acceptability, and accuracy of an automated AI retinal screening and CVD risk tool deployed in Australian primary care clinics, but does not test a specific deployment practice or guardrail variation.
